name: AppBar
title: AppBar
summary: The top bar of a mobile app screen: status bar, a 56px row with back, title and icon actions, and an optional large title or search field.
whenToUse: Use at the top of every screen in ISM apps such as dot.Bible.
Use the large title on root screens (Bible, Saved, Settings); collapse it to the centred 17px title once the content scrolls.
Use the back ‹ variant on any screen reached by drilling in (a chapter, a setting).
Use search mode when the reader taps the search field; it replaces the whole bar until Cancel.
whenNotToUse: Do not use it on websites; use SiteHeader there.

anatomy.description:
Status bar `.ap-sb` (40px) + `.ap-bar` row (56px). Inside a phone frame use `.ap-screen`; for isolated specimens use `.ap-iso`. Large title: `.ap-bar.ap-bar-end` (actions only) + `

Bible

` + `.ap-px` wrapping an `.ap-field` search field.

props.name: variant
props.description: `standard` is the 56px row, `large` adds a 32px title (and optional search field) for root screens, `search` replaces the bar with a search field and Cancel.

props.name: title
props.description: Screen title that names the place ("Bible", "John 3"). One line, under 20 characters.

props.name: back
props.description: Back button: shows ‹ plus the parent screen name, never "Back". Used on drilled-in screens.

props.name: actions
props.description: Trailing icon actions, at most three (extras are dropped; move them into More). Primary first, More last.

props.name: scrolled
props.description: Collapsed state after scroll: glass white with a hairline, centred title.

props.name: dark
props.description: Dark reader surface (`.ap-dark`).

props.name: glass
props.description: Use translucent glass action buttons for placing the bar over imagery (add your own scrim).

props.name: statusBar
props.description: Decorative status bar content (for phone-frame previews), e.g. a time and icons. Hidden from assistive tech.

props.name: searchPlaceholder
props.description: Large variant: placeholder of the search field under the title, e.g. "Search books and verses". Omit for no field.

props.name: onSearchOpen
props.description: Called when the search field under the large title or a search action is focused or tapped.

props.name: searchLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the search input.

props.name: searchValue
props.description: Search variant: input value.

props.name: onSearchChange
props.description: Search variant: called as the reader types.

props.name: onCancel
props.description: Search variant: called on Cancel (return focus to the search trigger).

props.name: cancelLabel
props.description: Search variant: Cancel text.

props.name: clearLabel
props.description: Search variant: accessible name of the Clear button.

props.name: title
props.description: Screen title. One line; keep under 20 characters. Becomes the screen heading.

props.name: variant
props.description: `bar` is the 56dp row with centred title; `large` adds a 32dp title below (root screens).

props.name: backLabel
props.description: Back button text: the parent screen's name, never "Back". Shows the back button when set together with `onBack`.

props.name: onBack
props.description: Called by the back button.

props.name: actions
props.description: Up to three trailing actions. Primary first (Share), More last. Extra actions are dropped: move them into More.

props.name: scrolled
props.description: The content has scrolled: glass background and hairline. A root screen at rest has no border.

props.name: overImage
props.description: Draw on imagery: transparent bar, white title and glass action buttons. Add your own scrim behind.

props.name: searchPlaceholder
props.description: Large variant: show a search field under the title that calls `onPressSearch`.

props.name: onPressSearch
props.description: Called when the search field in the large variant is pressed; swap to `search` mode in response.

props.name: search
props.description: Replace the bar by the search bar (field, Clear, Cancel).

props.name: safeAreaInsets
props.description: Safe-area insets; the bar pads its top by `top`. No extra dependency needed.

variants.classes: wrap status bar and bar in .ap-bar-scrolled (glass white + hairline); balance the title with .ap-tb-ghost
.ap-back (Horizon Blue, --blue-on-dark on dark) + up to three .ap-tb
parent .ap-dark; back turns --blue-on-dark, reader text white 88%

states.universal: See rules/states.md for the seven required states and their hooks.

rules: Every icon button is a 44×44 `.ap-tb`. Never shrink tap targets to fit more icons; move extras into More (⋯).
At most three trailing actions. Order: primary action first (Share), More last.
Back shows ‹ plus the parent screen name, never "Back".
The hairline and glass appear only after scroll. A root screen at rest has no border.
Over imagery, always add `.ap-img-scrim` and glass buttons; never put bare white icons on a photo.
Titles are one line and ellipsize; keep them under 20 characters.
Search field: 48px, `--radius-md`, `--gray-100` at rest, white with the Horizon Blue focus ring when active.

dont: Do not use it on websites; use SiteHeader there.
accessibility: Make the title the screen's heading (`h1` for large titles; announce screen changes).
Back must be a real button with its visible label; screen readers read "Books, button".
Put `role="search"` on the search bar; Clear has `aria-label="Clear search"`.
Keep the status bar decorative (`aria-hidden` icons).
content: Search placeholder says what can be found: "Search books and verses", "Search 500+ languages".
Over-image kicker + title: "Reading plan" / "7 days in the Psalms".
